entities.summary: Pyotr Anatolevich Kochetkov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Carolina Hurricanes of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was ranked as the top eligible international goaltender for the 2019 NHL entry draft, and was drafted in the second round by the Hurricanes. Kochetkov made his NHL debut in 2022 with the Hurricanes.
